description: This is a modern armchair with a unique geometric design. The armchair features a blocky seat cushion and a cylindrical back cushion, both upholstered in a dark grey fabric with a subtle woven texture. The frame is constructed from light wood, providing a visually striking contrast to the dark upholstery. The armrests are integrated into the overall frame, extending from the back and creating a partial enclosure. The base of the chair is also made from the same light wood, giving it a cohesive and contemporary look. Overall, the armchair is designed to be a stylish and comfortable seating option for modern living spaces.
